Hollingworth, appointed governor general by John Howard in 2001, resigned over his handling of child sexual abuse in the Anglican church Former governor general Peter Hollingworth, who resigned over his handling of child sexual abuse in the Anglican church, has died. Hollingworth, who devoted much of his life to fighting poverty, served as the Anglican archbishop of Brisbane for 11 years from 1990, the first Australian-born person to hold the position. Appointed governor general in 2001 by former Liberal prime minister John Howard, Hollingworth used his position to advocate for Indigenous rights and disadvantaged people. But Australia’s only clerical viceroy spent less than two years in the role before being forced to resign.

Peter Hollingworth failed to act on knowledge of child sexual abuse in the church, an inquiry found. Photo: AAP Former governor-general Peter Hollingworth, who resigned over his handling of child sexual abuse in the Anglican Church, has died. Hollingworth, who devoted much of his life to fighting poverty, served as the Anglican archbishop of Brisbane for 11 years from 1990. Appointed governor-general in 2001 by former Liberal prime minister John Howard, Hollingworth used his position to advocate for Indigenous rights and disadvantaged people. But he spent less than two years in the role before being forced to resign. In 2003, a board of inquiry into the handling of complaints of sexual abuse in the Anglican Diocese of Brisbane found that Hollingworth, as archbishop, failed to act on knowledge of abuse.

Former governor-general and retired Anglican archbishop Peter Hollingworth has died, aged 91. Dr Hollingworth died in Melbourne on Tuesday, reportedly having been unwell for a long time. Born in 1935, Hollingworth was ordained as an Anglican priest in 1960. Know the news with the 7NEWS app: Download today He was appointed an officer of the British Empire in 1976 and was named Australian of the Year in 1991. Hollingworth served as Australia’s 23rd governor-general between 2001 and 2003, having been appointed by then Liberal Prime Minister John Howard, but resigned following controversy over his handling of sex abuse claims against Anglican clergy. In 2003, a board of inquiry into the handling of complaints of sexual abuse in the Anglican Diocese of Brisbane found that Dr Hollingworth, as archbishop, failed to act on knowledge of abuse.

original_article.research:
[Lähde: The Guardian World]
Hollingworth, appointed governor general by John Howard in 2001, resigned over his handling of child sexual abuse in the Anglican church

Former governor general Peter Hollingworth, who resigned over his handling of child sexual abuse in the Anglican church, has died.

Hollingworth, who devoted much of his life to fighting poverty, served as the Anglican archbishop of Brisbane for 11 years from 1990, the first Australian-born person to hold the position.

Appointed governor general in 2001 by former Liberal prime minister John Howard, Hollingworth used his position to advocate for Indigenous rights and disadvantaged people.

But Australia’s only clerical viceroy spent less than two years in the role before being forced to resign.

In 2003, a board of inquiry into the handling of complaints of sexual abuse in the Anglican Diocese of Brisbane found that Hollingworth, as archbishop, failed to act on knowledge of abuse.

He allowed two priests to remain in the church despite knowing they had sexually assaulted children.

A church inquiry in 2023 found he had committed misconduct by allowing the pedophiles to remain in the church but said he remained fit for ministry.

Hollingworth accepted the investigation’s findings, saying he “made mistakes and I cannot undo them” but had committed no crimes.

There is no suggestion Hollingworth abused children himself.

In a statement on Tuesday, Anglican Archbishop of Brisbane Jeremy Greaves said the church sent its condolences to Hollingworth’s family.

“Anglican Church of Southern Queensland acknowledges with deep regret the past failings of the church,” he said.

“(It) apologises unreservedly to those who have suffered abuse, distress, isolation, and harm caused by the church’s failure to respond with integrity and care when it was needed most.”

Hollingworth was named Australian of the Year in 1991.

He announced in 2023 he would no longer practise as an Anglican priest to “end distress” for survivors.

payload.title: Australian entinen kenraalikuvernööri Peter Hollingworth on kuollut 91-vuotiaana
payload.summary: Australian entinen kenraalikuvernööri ja Brisbanen anglikaaninen arkkipiispa Peter Hollingworth on kuollut 91-vuotiaana. Hänen uransa muistetaan sekä köyhyyden ja alkuperäiskansojen oikeuksien puolustamisesta että erosta, joka seurasi kirkon hyväksikäyttövalitusten käsittelyä koskenutta arvostelua.
payload.content:
Australian entinen kenraalikuvernööri ja Brisbanen entinen anglikaaninen arkkipiispa Peter Hollingworth on kuollut 91-vuotiaana. Hollingworth kuoli Melbournessa tiistaina, ja tietojen mukaan hän oli ollut pitkään sairaana. Hänen julkinen uransa ulottui anglikaanisen kirkon johtotehtävistä Australian korkeimpaan edustukselliseen virkaan.

## Pitkä ura kirkossa ja yhteiskunnallisessa työssä

Hollingworth syntyi vuonna 1935 ja hänet vihittiin anglikaaniseksi papiksi vuonna 1960. Hän nousi Brisbanen anglikaaniseksi arkkipiispaksi vuonna 1990 ja toimi tehtävässä 11 vuoden ajan. Hän oli ensimmäinen Australiassa syntynyt henkilö, joka hoiti kyseistä virkaa.

Hollingworth tunnettiin myös sosiaalisesta työstään. Lähteiden mukaan hän omisti suuren osan elämästään köyhyyden vastaiselle työlle ja käytti julkista asemaansa alkuperäiskansojen oikeuksien sekä heikommassa asemassa olevien ihmisten asioiden esiin nostamiseen. Hänet nimitettiin Brittiläisen imperiumin upseeriksi vuonna 1976, ja vuonna 1991 hänet valittiin Australian vuoden henkilöksi.

## Kenraalikuvernöörin kausi jäi lyhyeksi

Kenraalikuvernööriksi Hollingworth nimitettiin vuonna 2001, kun pääministerinä toimi liberaalipuolueen John Howard. Hän oli Australian 23. kenraalikuvernööri ja lähteiden mukaan maan ainoa kirkollistaustainen varakuninkaan edustaja. Kausi jäi kuitenkin alle kahden vuoden mittaiseksi.

Hollingworth erosi tehtävästä vuonna 2003 kiistan jälkeen, joka liittyi hänen toimintaansa anglikaanisen kirkon seksuaalista hyväksikäyttöä koskeneiden tietojen ja valitusten käsittelyssä. Brisbanen anglikaanisen hiippakunnan valitusten käsittelyä tutkinut selvityselin katsoi vuonna 2003, että Hollingworth oli arkkipiispana jättänyt toimimatta, vaikka hänellä oli tietoa hyväksikäytöstä.

## Perintö jäi ristiriitaiseksi

Kiista johti voimakkaaseen julkiseen paineeseen ja lopulta hänen eroamiseensa kenraalikuvernöörin tehtävästä. Hollingworthin julkinen perintö jäi siksi kaksijakoiseksi: häntä pidettiin vuosikymmeniä näkyvänä köyhyyden vastaisen työn ja sosiaalisen oikeudenmukaisuuden puolustajana, mutta hänen uransa korkeimman viran päätti vakava arvostelu siitä, miten hän oli käsitellyt kirkon hyväksikäyttöväitteitä.
